card.name: Puzzlement and wondering phrases
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about being puzzled or curious, such as bothering me, has me wondering, wonder though, puzzle over, scratching their heads. It fires before the question or the thing that puzzles.

modes.label: Wondering or bothering
modes.description: Verbs or links in a speaker's statement that something puzzles them, ahead of a question.
modes.example: That has me<< wondering>>: If God created the world, then

modes.label: Scratching heads
modes.description: The idiom for being baffled, used for scientists or researchers.
